scope: Editorial summaries of existing published research. These are selected examples, not city totals, a new evidence review or current housing listings.

tucson.name: Tucson & Pima County
tucson.intro: Follow housing funding, explore reported results, and see what the records still cannot tell us.

findings.title: $1.5 million reallocated
findings.text: Tucson adopted a CDBG category transfer on October 6, 2026. It moves existing resources; it is not a new award or verified spending.

findings.title: 63 apartments reported opened
findings.text: City announcements describe Milagro on Oracle opening in January 2025. An opening report does not establish current vacancies.

findings.title: Two Amazon projects to distinguish
findings.text: The 59-apartment Flats project and the 30-studio motel conversion are different physical projects. The County packet's name and scope require care.

questions.title: What was paid, and from which program?
questions.text: Match commitments, draws and expenditure records before describing a usable balance.

questions.title: Which housing assistance was executed?
questions.text: Proposed vouchers, allocations and signed assistance contracts describe different stages.

questions.title: Which homes and milestones can be verified?
questions.text: Read the outstanding project records alongside reported openings and renovations.

stage_examples.label: A reported closing ratification at Amazon Flats

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.intro: Follow housing funding, explore reported results, and see what the records still cannot tell us.

findings.title: 53 apartments reported completed
findings.text: The draft FY2025–26 CAPER reports 25th @ Bell completed. This is draft reporting, not a current occupancy or vacancy check.

findings.title: Two planned Moreland phases
findings.text: The June 17, 2026 Council report describes 132 and 105 planned apartments. The combined 237 is not completed Phase I housing.

findings.title: A closing is a financing record
findings.text: Phoenix IDA reports a $43.1 million Moreland I closing in December 2025. It does not establish City spending or final development cost.

questions.title: Which assisted apartments overlap?
questions.text: Different programs can designate apartments at the same property. Match the schedules before counting unique homes.

questions.title: What was actually paid?
questions.text: Project-specific disbursements are needed before calculating spending per apartment.

questions.title: How do differing records connect?
questions.text: An executed amendment or explanatory transaction may be needed; a later date alone does not reconcile the statements.

stage_examples.label: Why an annual Capital Fund expenditure row needs context

project-pub-001.name: Amazon Flats
project-pub-001.funding: Financial closing ratified April 8, 2026; actual disbursements remain unverified.
project-pub-001.caution: Separate from the 30-studio Amazon Motel conversion. Proposed vouchers and HOME designations are not additional homes.

project-pub-002.name: Craycroft Towers & Lee Street
project-pub-002.funding: 82 project-based vouchers allocated; executed HAP contracts remain unverified.
project-pub-002.caution: These are existing homes, not 82 newly constructed apartments or available vacancies.

project-pub-003.name: Milagro on Oracle
project-pub-003.funding: A comparable spending total is not established in this project summary.
project-pub-003.caution: A reported opening is not an audited resident count or a current vacancy listing.

project-pub-004.name: Amazon Motel Conversion
project-pub-004.funding: $749,625 described in County packet PO2500016491; execution remains unverified.
project-pub-004.caution: The packet uses the name Amazon Flats but describes the motel conversion. Published signature lines are blank.

project-pub-005.name: Tucson House Renovation
project-pub-005.funding: A comparable project-spending total is not established in this summary.
project-pub-005.caution: The 24 apartments and 25 announced households remain unreconciled. The permit register lists a November 15, 2026 expiration; current validity and vacancies are unverified.

project-bell.name: 25th @ Bell
project-bell.funding: Separate City and State HOME activities; funding fields are not verified cash payments.
project-bell.caution: Assisted-unit designations can overlap. Draft completion reporting does not establish current occupancy or vacancies.

project-pueblo.name: Pueblo Apartments
project-pueblo.funding: A complete financing history and comparable spending total are not established here.
project-pueblo.caution: This is one of five reported projects, not a separate citywide housing total or a current availability listing.

project-garfield-ii.name: Garfield II
project-garfield-ii.funding: A complete financing history and comparable spending total are not established here.
project-garfield-ii.caution: Match the project's identity before combining it with another Garfield phase.

project-falcon-park.name: Residences at Falcon Park
project-falcon-park.funding: A comparable project-spending total is not established in the reviewed finding.
project-falcon-park.caution: Draft reported completion does not establish current occupancy or available apartments.

project-harmony.name: Harmony at the Park
project-harmony.stage: Existing inventory · May 2026 directory; Phase III also in draft FY2025–26 CAPER
project-harmony.funding: A comparable spending total across the three phases is not established here.
project-harmony.caution: Phase III's 90 apartments appear in both records. Do not add the draft completion count to the 325-home inventory.

project-moreland.name: The Moreland
project-moreland.place: Phoenix · former Deck Park Vista site
project-moreland.stage: Planned phases · June 17, 2026 Council scope report
project-moreland.homes: 132 Phase I + 105 Phase II planned apartments
project-moreland.funding: Phase I: $43.1m reported closing, December 2025. Phase II: up to $10m authorized, June 17, 2026.
project-moreland.caution: 237 is planned scope, not completed Phase I housing. Closing and authorization amounts are not City spending; Phase II's fund split and execution remain unverified.

project-girasol.name: Girasol
project-girasol.place: Phoenix · former Sidney P. Osborn site
project-girasol.funding: A comparable project-spending total is not established in this summary.
project-girasol.caution: Gross redevelopment scope is not net new housing. Construction percentages and move-in forecasts are not occupied homes.

project-marcos-grant-park.name: Marcos de Niza–Grant Park
project-marcos-grant-park.homes: No apartment-delivery count established by this award
project-marcos-grant-park.funding: $500,000 announced for planning and transformation-plan work.
